content.user_title: Review Execution Plans Before Coding Starts
content.value_statement: Execution plans often pass review while still missing acceptance criteria, deltas, or verification steps, which causes rework during implementation. This skill routes each plan to the correct review lane and checklist, then returns graded blockers so a plan is only marked implementation-ready when it is truly executable.
actual_capabilities: Classifies each request into Express, Direct, Standard, or Full lanes and applies the matching review depth.
Runs a numbered checklist that verifies frozen tables, Delta specs, acceptance criteria, prerequisites, and verification steps.
Emits graded findings (major or blocker) with reason codes such as stale_dispatch and campaign_skip.
Requires sub-window execution with an explicit model parameter so findings are not produced in the main window.
Returns a blocker list, gap suggestions, and a confirmation package instead of editing the reviewed document.
Keeps a read-only stance: the reviewer has no write permission to the execution document.
limitations: The skill is written in Chinese and its trigger phrases are Chinese (方案审核 and 审方案).
Most referenced files live outside the skill folder, so relative links break when the skill is installed alone.
It depends on shared repository documents such as CORE.md and other sibling skills to resolve its pointers.
It only reviews documents; it does not change code or the execution document status.

use_cases.title: Pre-implementation plan gate
use_cases.description: Submit an execution document and receive graded blockers before any coding begins.

use_cases.title: Acceptance and delta verification
use_cases.description: Confirm that every step maps to acceptance criteria and a Delta spec before sign-off.

use_cases.title: Cross-module change routing
use_cases.description: Route multi-module plans to the correct review lane and isolation depth.

prompt_templates.title: First plan review
prompt_templates.scenario: A single execution document is ready and you want a first pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: 方案审核：review this execution document and list every blocker and gap.

prompt_templates.title: Check acceptance coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to know whether each step satisfies an acceptance criterion.
prompt_templates.prompt: 审方案：check whether every Step satisfies an acceptance A# and report missing Delta items.

prompt_templates.title: Route the review lane
prompt_templates.scenario: The change spans several business modules and the lane is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: 方案审核：this change spans two business modules. Tell me which review lane it needs and whether isolated review is required.

prompt_templates.title: Full audit with reason codes
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a complete pass with traceable reason codes.
prompt_templates.prompt: 方案审核：run the full checklist over the whole plan and return graded blockers, gaps, and suggestions, with a reason code for each item.

output_examples.input: 方案审核：review the checkout refactor plan.
output: Lane: Full, because the change spans two modules.
Blocker: step 3 has no acceptance A# mapping.
Major: the API response has no frozen table.
Gap: add a Delta spec for the retry behavior.

output_examples.output: Lane: Standard, L1. No blockers found. One major: the verification step is missing. Recommendation: send a confirmation package before coding starts.
Please tag the request with 方案审核 or 审方案 so the plan-reviewer lane activates. I will then return graded blockers and gaps for the execution document.

best_practices: Tag the request with 方案审核 or 审方案 so the correct review lane activates.
Provide the execution document and the named dispatch file up front, because the reviewer reads only the whitelist it is given.
Treat every blocker as a gate and resolve it before requesting implementation-ready status.
anti_patterns: Asking for a review while expecting approval, then treating blockers as optional.
Pasting the long rule text into findings instead of returning short graded results.
Skipping the lane check and running a shallow review on a cross-module plan.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It reviews an execution document for executability and returns graded blockers and gaps.

faq.question: Which phrases trigger it?
faq.answer: The Chinese phrases 方案审核 and 审方案. The Express lane is skipped.

faq.question: Does it edit my plan?
faq.answer: No. The reviewer is read-only and never changes the execution document status.

faq.question: What are the review lanes?
faq.answer: Express, Direct, Standard, and Full. Each lane sets its own review depth and isolation.

faq.question: What is a blocker?
faq.answer: A blocker is a defect that prevents the plan from being marked implementation-ready.

faq.question: Does it work on its own?
faq.answer: Partly. Many referenced files live outside the skill folder, so it works best inside its home repository.
